author: Syed Mashkoorul Hassan
title: Hiring 2D Animators for Rano Chidiya Cartoon
content:
🎨 We’re Hiring 2D Animators! 🐦✨

Love animation, cartoon storytelling, and bringing characters to life? Rano Chidiya Cartoon is looking for creative 2D Animators who are skilled in Adobe Animate, Photoshop & Illustrator and understand storytelling.

📩 Apply Now: work.tunistorytv@gmail.com

🎬 Send your portfolio/showreel along with your application.

Join us and help bring amazing cartoon stories to life! 🌳🐦✨

author: Malaka Books
title: Open Call for Book Designers & Illustrators
content:
FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Nah, buat kamu para illustrator dan designer, kami lagi ngebuka kesempatan kolaborasi untuk terlibat langsung dalam proses penerbitan buku cetak. 

Tidak ada deadline ya, silahkan mendaftar jika tertarik, akan kami cek berkala.

Tertarik buat gabung? Langsung isi formulir di sini ya 👇
